assets.title: Wind across the whole southern archipelago in four seasons
assets.scope: Four maps from 76°W–65°W and 52°S–56°S compare the surrounding ocean with the Strait of Magellan and Tierra del Fuego. Arrows show mean wind vectors; colour indicates speed in metres per second.

assets.alt: Four regional wind maps showing faster winds west of the islands and differences between three-month groups.
assets.credit: Castillo et al. (2026), Ocean Science 22, 2221–2247, Figure 3; ERA5 reanalysis data © ECMWF/Copernicus.
assets.rights: CC BY 4.0
assets.license: CC BY 4.0
assets.processing: Published figure retained in full at 1,892 × 1,127 pixels and converted to WebP. Panel codes retained; the source caption’s inconsistent prose expansion of AMJ/JAS is not repeated.
